title: Telemetry evidence overlay
description: One file per telemetry source under data/observed/, generated by scripts/ingest-observed.js. Holds the source's policy block verbatim, the revision it was read at, and per client the observed-tier Evidence records keyed by capability id, plus the protocol revision mix. The Evidence shape is the registry schema's.

source.description: Short identifier, as used in Evidence.source.

url.description: The report file at the pinned revision.

revision.description: The source repository revision the report was read at.

policy.description: The report's policy block, verbatim. Every observed record in this file is read against it.

historicalWindow.description: The window of the initialize-era backfill that can also set a capability flag, when the source has one.

registryId.description: The id in data/clients.json, joined on clientInfoNames.

sourceNames.description: Wire clientInfo.name values the source groups under this client.

protocolMix30d.description: Share of tool calls by protocol revision over the 30 days ending `protocolMixDate`.

capabilities.description: Capability id (data/spec-versions.json vocabulary) to the evidence the source gives for it.
